paragraphs.text: But I determined this for myself, that I would not come again to you with sorrow.
paragraphs.original: ἔκρινα γὰρ ἐμαυτῷ τοῦτο, τὸ μὴ πάλιν ἐν λύπῃ πρὸς ὑμᾶς ἐλθεῖν·
paragraphs.translit: ekrina gar emautō touto, to mē palin en lypē pros hymas elthein·

paragraphs.text: For if I make you sorry, who then is he that maketh me glad but he that is made sorry by me?
paragraphs.original: εἰ γὰρ ἐγὼ λυπῶ ὑμᾶς, καὶ τίς ὁ εὐφραίνων με εἰ μὴ ὁ λυπούμενος ἐξ ἐμοῦ;
paragraphs.translit: ei gar egō lypō hymas, kai tis ho euphrainōn me ei mē ho lypoumenos ex emou;

paragraphs.text: And I wrote this very thing, lest, when I came, I should have sorrow from them of whom I ought to rejoice; having confidence in you all, that my joy is [the joy] of you all.
paragraphs.original: καὶ ἔγραψα τοῦτο αὐτὸ ἵνα μὴ ἐλθὼν λύπην σχῶ ἀφʼ ὧν ἔδει με χαίρειν, πεποιθὼς ἐπὶ πάντας ὑμᾶς ὅτι ἡ ἐμὴ χαρὰ πάντων ὑμῶν ἐστιν.
paragraphs.translit: kai egrapsa touto auto hina mē elthōn lypēn schō aphʼ hōn edei me chairein, pepoithōs epi pantas hymas hoti hē emē chara pantōn hymōn estin.

paragraphs.text: For out of much affliction and anguish of heart I wrote unto you with many tears; not that ye should be made sorry, but that ye might know the love that I have more abundantly unto you.
paragraphs.original: ἐκ γὰρ πολλῆς θλίψεως καὶ συνοχῆς καρδίας ἔγραψα ὑμῖν διὰ πολλῶν δακρύων, οὐχ ἵνα λυπηθῆτε, ἀλλὰ τὴν ἀγάπην ἵνα γνῶτε ἣν ἔχω περισσοτέρως εἰς ὑμᾶς.
paragraphs.translit: ek gar pollēs thlipseōs kai synochēs kardias egrapsa hymin dia pollōn dakryōn, ouch hina lypēthēte, alla tēn agapēn hina gnōte hēn echō perissoterōs eis hymas.

paragraphs.text: But if any hath caused sorrow, he hath caused sorrow, not to me, but in part (that I press not too heavily) to you all.
paragraphs.original: Εἰ δέ τις λελύπηκεν, οὐκ ἐμὲ λελύπηκεν, ἀλλὰ ἀπὸ μέρους ἵνα μὴ ἐπιβαρῶ πάντας ὑμᾶς.
paragraphs.translit: Ei de tis lelypēken, ouk eme lelypēken, alla apo merous hina mē epibarō pantas hymas.

paragraphs.text: Sufficient to such a one is this punishment which was [inflicted] by the many;
paragraphs.original: ἱκανὸν τῷ τοιούτῳ ἡ ἐπιτιμία αὕτη ἡ ὑπὸ τῶν πλειόνων,
paragraphs.translit: hikanon tō toioutō hē epitimia hautē hē hypo tōn pleionōn,

paragraphs.text: so that contrariwise ye should rather forgive him and comfort him, lest by any means such a one should be swallowed up with his overmuch sorrow.
paragraphs.original: ὥστε τοὐναντίον μᾶλλον ὑμᾶς χαρίσασθαι καὶ παρακαλέσαι, μή πως τῇ περισσοτέρᾳ λύπῃ καταποθῇ ὁ τοιοῦτος.
paragraphs.translit: hōste tounantion mallon hymas charisasthai kai parakalesai, mē pōs tē perissotera lypē katapothē ho toioutos.

paragraphs.text: Wherefore I beseech you to confirm [your] love toward him.
paragraphs.original: διὸ παρακαλῶ ὑμᾶς κυρῶσαι εἰς αὐτὸν ἀγάπην·
paragraphs.translit: dio parakalō hymas kyrōsai eis auton agapēn·

paragraphs.text: For to this end also did I write, that I might know the proof of you, whether ye are obedient in all things.
paragraphs.original: εἰς τοῦτο γὰρ καὶ ἔγραψα ἵνα γνῶ τὴν δοκιμὴν ὑμῶν, εἰ εἰς πάντα ὑπήκοοί ἐστε.
paragraphs.translit: eis touto gar kai egrapsa hina gnō tēn dokimēn hymōn, ei eis panta hypēkooi este.

paragraphs.text: But to whom ye forgive anything, I [forgive] also: for what I also have forgiven, if I have forgiven anything, for your sakes [have I forgiven it] in the presence of Christ;
paragraphs.original: ᾧ δέ τι χαρίζεσθε, κἀγώ· καὶ γὰρ ἐγὼ ὃ κεχάρισμαι, εἴ τι κεχάρισμαι, διʼ ὑμᾶς ἐν προσώπῳ Χριστοῦ,
paragraphs.translit: hō de ti charizesthe, kagō· kai gar egō ho kecharismai, ei ti kecharismai, diʼ hymas en prosōpō Christou,

paragraphs.text: that no advantage may be gained over us by Satan: for we are not ignorant of his devices.
paragraphs.original: ἵνα μὴ πλεονεκτηθῶμεν ὑπὸ τοῦ Σατανᾶ, οὐ γὰρ αὐτοῦ τὰ νοήματα ἀγνοοῦμεν.
paragraphs.translit: hina mē pleonektēthōmen hypo tou Satana, ou gar autou ta noēmata agnooumen.

paragraphs.text: Now when I came to Troas for the gospel of Christ, and when a door was opened unto me in the Lord,
paragraphs.original: Ἐλθὼν δὲ εἰς τὴν Τρῳάδα εἰς τὸ εὐαγγέλιον τοῦ Χριστοῦ καὶ θύρας μοι ἀνεῳγμένης ἐν κυρίῳ,
paragraphs.translit: Elthōn de eis tēn Trōada eis to euangelion tou Christou kai thyras moi aneōgmenēs en kyriō,

paragraphs.text: I had no relief for my spirit, because I found not Titus my brother: but taking my leave of them, I went forth into Macedonia.
paragraphs.original: οὐκ ἔσχηκα ἄνεσιν τῷ πνεύματί μου τῷ μὴ εὑρεῖν με Τίτον τὸν ἀδελφόν μου, ἀλλὰ ἀποταξάμενος αὐτοῖς ἐξῆλθον εἰς Μακεδονίαν.
paragraphs.translit: ouk eschēka anesin tō pneumati mou tō mē heurein me Titon ton adelphon mou, alla apotaxamenos autois exēlthon eis Makedonian.

paragraphs.text: But thanks be unto God, who always leadeth us in triumph in Christ, and maketh manifest through us the savor of his knowledge in every place.
paragraphs.original: Τῷ δὲ θεῷ χάρις τῷ πάντοτε θριαμβεύοντι ἡμᾶς ἐν τῷ Χριστῷ καὶ τὴν ὀσμὴν τῆς γνώσεως αὐτοῦ φανεροῦντι διʼ ἡμῶν ἐν παντὶ τόπῳ·
paragraphs.translit: Tō de theō charis tō pantote thriambeuonti hēmas en tō Christō kai tēn osmēn tēs gnōseōs autou phanerounti diʼ hēmōn en panti topō·

paragraphs.text: For we are a sweet savor of Christ unto God, in them that are saved, and in them that perish;
paragraphs.original: ὅτι Χριστοῦ εὐωδία ἐσμὲν τῷ θεῷ ἐν τοῖς σῳζομένοις καὶ ἐν τοῖς ἀπολλυμένοις,
paragraphs.translit: hoti Christou euōdia esmen tō theō en tois sōzomenois kai en tois apollymenois,

paragraphs.text: to the one a savor from death unto death; to the other a savor from life unto life. And who is sufficient for these things?
paragraphs.original: οἷς μὲν ὀσμὴ ἐκ θανάτου εἰς θάνατον, οἷς δὲ ὀσμὴ ἐκ ζωῆς εἰς ζωήν. καὶ πρὸς ταῦτα τίς ἱκανός;
paragraphs.translit: hois men osmē ek thanatou eis thanaton, hois de osmē ek zōēs eis zōēn. kai pros tauta tis hikanos;

paragraphs.text: For we are not as the many, corrupting the word of God: but as of sincerity, but as of God, in the sight of God, speak we in Christ.
paragraphs.original: οὐ γάρ ἐσμεν ὡς οἱ πολλοὶ καπηλεύοντες τὸν λόγον τοῦ θεοῦ, ἀλλʼ ὡς ἐξ εἰλικρινείας, ἀλλʼ ὡς ἐκ θεοῦ κατέναντι θεοῦ ἐν Χριστῷ λαλοῦμεν.
paragraphs.translit: ou gar esmen hōs hoi polloi kapēleuontes ton logon tou theou, allʼ hōs ex eilikrineias, allʼ hōs ek theou katenanti theou en Christō laloumen.
